mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot (job_id, execution_id, start_time, snapshot_json) SELECT execution.job_id, execution.id, execution.start_time, #{snapshotJson} FROM sys_schedule_job_execution_log execution WHERE execution.job_id = #{jobId} AND execution.id = #{executionId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE snapshot_json = CASE WHEN sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.start_time < VALUES(start_time) OR (sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.start_time = VALUES(start_time) AND sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.execution_id < VALUES(execution_id)) THEN VALUES(snapshot_json) ELSE sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.snapshot_json END, execution_id = CASE WHEN sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.start_time < VALUES(start_time) OR (sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.start_time = VALUES(start_time) AND sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.execution_id < VALUES(execution_id)) THEN VALUES(execution_id) ELSE sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.execution_id END, start_time = GREATEST(sys_schedule_job_request_snapshot.start_time, VALUES(start_time))
